name: 300 Montgomery Street
note: Classical Chicago-style commercial tower with regular punched windows and prominent classical base. Photos 2-3 show clear facade with light tan ashlar, regular grid of windows, about 12 stories. Modeled using chicago-block recipe with custom wall color and base treatment.

name: 550 California Street
note: Mid-century modern building with distinctive arched base openings and vertical ribbed wall/fins above. Photos 2-3 show cream/tan color with vertical ribbing running full height. About 11-12 stories. Modeled with arched base tier and vertical fins for main tower.

name: Modern Tower with Vertical Fins
note: Contemporary glass tower with prominent vertical dark blue/metal fins and dark glass curtain wall. Photos 1 and 3 show the narrow slab-like form with strong vertical rhythm. About 10 stories. Modeled as modern glass tower with tall vertical fins.

name: Institute of Contemporary Art, 345 Montgomery Street
note: Modern minimalist building with distinctive dark stone base featuring large arched openings and recessed glazed wall above. Photos 1 and 3 show the dark material and arched entrance. About 6 stories. Modeled with arched base and recessed curtain wall above.

name: Alvinza Hayward Building, 400 Montgomery Street
note: Beaux-Arts classical tower with prominent columns/pilasters, horizontal banding, and regular punched window grid. Photos 1 and 3 show light tan facade with classical base treatment and cornice detailing. About 9 stories. Modeled using chicago-block recipe with classical ashlar material.
